book.welcome.name: book.welcome.counter.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A note for the counter

book.welcome.name: book.welcome.counter.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Welcome to Neon Undertow. The new customers, factions and shops join your normal playthrough; there is no activation key. Customers arrive through ordinary visits, so you will meet them over time.\n\nKeep this little book cubby in your main shop or put it inside the Dossier to sort your collection. Double-click it to open, then activate a handbook to read. Use the book's index and page arrows. You can take a book out and move it like any other item.

book.welcome.name: book.welcome.shortcut.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Keep the counter clear

book.welcome.name: book.welcome.shortcut.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started:
The corner guide is off by default. If you prefer a shortcut, open Mods, select Neon Undertow, then Settings and turn on Show corner guide. The change takes effect immediately. Startup status is also available there.

The cubby accepts your owned books and paper documents, including vanilla handbooks. Recipe books still need to be bought or earned. Move a recipe book into its machine's INPUT when you want to craft. Keeping it in this cubby does not unlock production remotely.

Replacement Undertow guides and empty cubbies are sold on the Co-op's KITCHEN + BOOKS shelf.

book.welcome.name: book.neighborhood.name
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Neon Undertow: Around the Neighborhood

book.welcome.name: book.neighborhood.people.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: People and factions

book.welcome.name: book.neighborhood.people.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Open FACTIONS and use Next to find the new communities after the vanilla groups. Hover reputation milestones to see what they offer and what happens if your standing falls.\n\nOpen your shop and serve visitors normally. Neon Undertow adds regulars to the customer pools, including the Velvet Quay community and upper-class visitors. Story customers keep their original roles.

book.welcome.name: book.neighborhood.night.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: After closing

book.welcome.name: book.neighborhood.night.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started:
Once the shop closes, use the normal travel/map menu to visit the night shops.

Quayside Canning Co-op stocks produce, cans, kitchen supplies and books. Its shelves are divided into SODA SUPPLIES, PRODUCE, KITCHEN + BOOKS and CELLAR. Finish a purchase or return the unbought item before changing shelves.

Stock renews daily. Your faction standing can affect offers and prices.

book.welcome.name: book.neighborhood.equipment.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Equipment and fixtures

book.welcome.name: book.neighborhood.equipment.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Stormglass Depot Outlet carries storage and water equipment. Undertow Engineering supplies production modules, attachments and packaging pattern chips.\n\nGlassmarket Counter & Fixture Stall stocks signs, lamps and bar equipment: a tool rail, measures, a mixing glass, shaker, blender, serving glass and a bartender's notebook. The tools are separate items; the rail is storage for them.

book.welcome.name: book.neighborhood.backroom.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Make room to work

book.welcome.name: book.neighborhood.backroom.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started:
Click the arrow at the bottom right of the shop to reach the back room. The worktop shares your front counter stock; click it to cook. Click the cabinet or a fitted machine to open it, and the door to return to the shop.

Joe Wild's BACK ROOM services add station bays, storage tiers and fitted equipment. Buy the actual machine before fitting it.

Keep this guide and the book cubby in the main area if that is where you prefer to read.

book.welcome.name: book.workshop.name
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Neon Undertow: Workshop Fieldbook

book.welcome.name: book.workshop.cooking.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Produce and cooking

book.welcome.name: book.workshop.cooking.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started:
Buy cooking tools and recipe books at Quayside Canning Co-op. Click the back-room worktop to open the kitchen. Fit tools in their top slots and charged cells in BATTERIES. Put ingredients, water and an optional fridge in INPUT. A fridge needs its own battery.

Choose a dish from your recipe books, then press Craft: the listed ingredients, water and power are consumed. Tools and books are kept. Heated recipes still need a galley or a heating plate; chilled recipes need a powered fridge.

For an unambiguous single-ingredient recipe, you can also drag the matching tool onto the ingredient.

book.welcome.name: book.workshop.canning.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Canning and workshop supplies

book.welcome.name: book.workshop.canning.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started:
Buy the Fizzworks Soda Canner at Stormglass Depot Outlet after hours.

Put the Fizzyworks recipe book in the canning machine input. For other production recipes, use the matching recipe manual and the game's item picker. Supply the listed ingredients, water, packaging and power. Tools and books are kept.

Soda accepts water above Basewater grade. Source water and container condition affect quality. Flavour ingredients are not dirty water.

To make empty metal packaging, use the native printer with a matching chip from Undertow Engineering, metal, the required modules and charged batteries.

book.welcome.name: book.workshop.water.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Waterworks

book.welcome.name: book.workshop.water.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started:
The Industrial Water Generator becomes available at Stormglass Depot from day 28 when you have a Grand Waterworks installed. Its list price is 12,500 credits.

Fit a charged cell. Overnight it generates and fills up to four native 2 L high-quality water bottles, using six power each: 24 for a full set. It needs no ingredient or empty-bottle input. Leave room in OUTPUT.

Starting traits do not grant this generator. Items left in older input or attachment slots stay retrievable. The Waterworks handbook explains the manual bottling equipment and its recipes.

book.welcome.name: book.workshop.cellar.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Cellar and bar

book.welcome.name: book.workshop.cellar.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started:
The Co-op's CELLAR shelf sells a Cellar Bench, Brewing Notes, bottles and culture. Its 76 recipes cover suitable fruits, grains, starch crops and infusions. Choose Ferment, Distill or Infuse and load one combination; batches take nights.

The CELLAR tab stores finished bottles. Use the native powered Age-Well rack for suitable wines, cider and perry. Bottled spirits do not mature merely by being stored.

At the bar, pour using ordinary inventory targeting. Measure portions, activate the mixing glass to stir or the shaker to shake, then pour into a bottle. Stir carbonated drinks. The blender extracts produce juices. Read the bartender's notebook for quantities and recipes.

book.welcome.name: book.help.name
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Neon Undertow: Help Notes

book.welcome.name: book.help.missing.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Finding missing content

book.welcome.name: book.help.missing.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started:
Enable Neon Undertow in Mods and restart the game. Check Startup status in its Settings. If Steam is still downloading an update, close the game and let it finish before reopening.

New factions are on the later FACTIONS pages. Customer options can disable future arrivals; settings marked Restart required need a restart. Night shops are reached after closing.

The corner shortcut is optional. Hiding it does not disable any content or remove your books.

book.welcome.name: book.help.saves.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Existing saves

book.welcome.name: book.help.saves.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Neon Undertow runs independently and includes its own Cellar Bench and brewing recipes. Back up a save before changing its mod set.\n\nThe starter cubby is delivered once per playthrough when there is room on the main counter, including existing saves that have not received it. It does not refill after you move or sell its books. Your cubby contents and bookmarks use the normal item save system.

book.welcome.name: book.help.report.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: If something goes wrong

book.welcome.name: book.help.report.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started:
If back-room cargo cannot load, saving is blocked to protect the original items. Return to the menu and report the problem.

For a bug report, include the game and mod versions, whether the save is new or existing, other enabled mods, and the steps that led to the problem. A screenshot helps. Startup failures are recorded in Player.log.

The guide explains the tools; it does not repair items, test liquids or skip recipe requirements.

book.welcome.name: book.rats.name
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Rat Keeper's Breeding Notes

book.welcome.name: book.rats.start.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Find the new rats

book.welcome.name: book.rats.start.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started:
The rat start gives six rats of the usual ages and sexes. Each carries a random standard coat over an ordinary allele and one inherited strength. Breed them together to mix coats and traits. Two parents with only ordinary coat alleles have a 1 in 32 chance per pup of producing a new standard coat.

After closing the shop, visit Quayside Canning Co-op and open RATS + CARE. Standard coat varieties are sold individually from day 7. Hairless, heavy and cow-spotted milk lines arrive on day 14; rare coats on day 21. Each animal offer renews once per seven-day stock period.

Use the normal animal cage, feed dispenser, marking pen, weighing, feeding, mating and butchering tools. Growth, sex, health, hygiene, disease, pregnancy, overcrowding and mating limits follow the base game. Leave room for growing animals and new litters; a good breeder needs more care, not less.

book.welcome.name: book.rats.traits.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Choose breeding stock

book.welcome.name: book.rats.traits.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started:
The animal tooltip calls out inherited strengths and weaknesses using its native expressed genes. A trait at I is at least 20% above the species baseline; II is at least 50%. Thrifty eater needs at least 20% or 35% lower hunger demand instead.

Breeder: fertility. Large litters: offspring potential. Meaty: growth and actual body weight. Long-lived: old-age threshold. Hardy: immunity. Sturdy: maximum health. Thrifty eater: hunger demand.

These names describe the genes; they do not stack another buff. Current care, age, disease and native treatment bonuses can change performance. Traits can be inherited from either sex, including litter potential from a male.

book.welcome.name: book.rats.selection.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Breed for better traits

book.welcome.name: book.rats.selection.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started:
Compare parents, keep useful offspring and breed the next generation. The game chooses one allele from each parent for every native statistic and applies its normal mutation rules. Offspring are not guaranteed copies or guaranteed improvements.

Starter lines offer different strengths: Charcoal/Smoke favour breeding and litter size; Slate/Blue-grey favour meat growth but eat more; Chestnut/Fawn live longer; Russet/Cinnamon favour immunity and health; Olive agouti/Cream eat less but grow a little slower. Cross lines to combine strengths.

The native marking pen can help identify keepers. Physical statistics remain continuous, so two animals with the same trait name can still differ. Negative labels identify genes below baseline.

book.welcome.name: book.rats.coats.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Coats and carriers

book.welcome.name: book.rats.coats.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started:
Five ordinary coat families have distinct male and female palettes: Charcoal/Smoke, Slate/Blue-grey, Chestnut/Fawn, Russet/Cinnamon, Olive agouti/Cream. These use refined native rat bodies at all five original weight stages, including dead poses. Sex remains the native male/female state.

Each pup receives one coat allele from each parent. Different standard coats express the earlier family in the list while keeping both alleles. A standard coat expresses over normal or rare. Coats do not change fertility or health by themselves.

This is a simple game breeding model. Visible colour does not reveal every carried allele. Keep breeding records.

book.welcome.name: book.rats.rare.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Rare coats and fur

book.welcome.name: book.rats.rare.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started:
Pearl, Champagne and Silver are the three rare coats; each is available in either sex. A rare coat shows only when both inherited alleles match. Rare x normal gives normal-looking carriers. Two carriers of the same rare coat can give about one rare pup in four over many births. Different rare coats do not combine into a free new premium colour.

Extra furry is a separate recessive trait. Both fur alleles must be present for visible tufts. The Russet/Cinnamon starter line carries two; cross it into any coat. Fur does not enlarge the inventory footprint or grant health.

Coat, fur and physical genetics save on the animal. A pregnant female also saves the father's contribution until birth.

book.welcome.name: book.rats.market.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Meat and the market

book.welcome.name: book.rats.market.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Care and weight still determine the meat yield. Live rats also have a pet value. Standard coats add 15%, rare coats add 100%, and shaggy fur adds 15%. Markings and breeding traits add value when you buy or sell a rat.\n\nRats and fish share 40 breeding traits. Young can take after either parent or develop a new trait. Seven traits on one offspring is a one-in-10,000 birth. Upper-level regulars, Amara Dune and Mina Rose buy pets at the counter.

book.welcome.name: book.rats.markings.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Recognise inherited looks

book.welcome.name: book.rats.markings.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started:
Traits also change the rat itself, in every coat and native growth stage.

Meaty: a fuller back and body. Sturdy: a broader shoulder. Extra furry: a rough, tufted outline.

Breeder: a pale flank saddle. Large litters: a pale belly. Long-lived: a pale muzzle. Hardy: a dark back stripe. Thrifty eater: a pale rump. These markings are game breeding-line identifiers, not real-world diagnoses. They can combine on one animal.

The look follows expressed inherited strengths. It does not reveal hidden carrier genes, exact performance, pregnancy or disease. Most I and II markings share a visual family; Meaty II develops a very heavy body after reaching 180 g. Inspect the native stats to compare quality. Colour, texture and markings survive saving and growing without changing cage footprints.

book.welcome.name: book.rats.hairless.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Hairless and heavy lines

book.welcome.name: book.rats.hairless.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started:
Hairlessness is a second recessive form at the coat-texture locus. Two hairless alleles produce bare skin with folds; one hidden allele is carried without showing. Extra-furry x hairless parents produce smooth-looking carriers of both forms. Later generations can express either, according to the inherited pair. Existing smooth and extra-furry lines keep their genes.

Meaty II animals use a very heavy body after reaching 180 g through normal growth. They keep their native weight stages, meat yield and cage rules. Heavy starter stock has stronger growth genes and a bigger appetite, but starts at normal newborn weight. If starvation reduces weight below 180 g, the heavy body stops showing.

Hairless and heavy-line male/female starters arrive on RATS + CARE from day 14, one per weekly stock period. Hairless 90 credits; heavy line 100.

Colours remain inherited independently. On hairless animals they appear as warm skin pigmentation. Heavy builds combine with smooth, shaggy or hairless skin; crossing lines may take several generations. Neither hairlessness nor the heavy appearance adds a separate price or health bonus.

book.welcome.name: book.rats.milk.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Cow spots and rat milk

book.welcome.name: book.rats.milk.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started:
Cow spots identify an inherited milk line, in any colour, texture or body build. Two milk-line alleles are needed for visible spots. Males pass the line to offspring but do not produce milk. A cross with an ordinary rat gives unspotted carriers; two carriers can produce spotted pups. Quayside stocks both sexes from day 14, 100 credits each, one per week.

Raise a female to native maturity and breed her normally. After a litter, the next seven fed care cycles provide up to 10 mL of collectable surplus per day. This is a game-scale allowance after nursing. Uncollected surplus does not accumulate; starvation or death stops collection. Repeated clicks and reloads do not refill it.

Select the nursing rat, then target an owned bottle, jug or other compatible liquid container. At least 1 mL of space is needed. Only what fits is collected; the rest stays available for that care cycle. Empty bottles remain reusable. Milk contains native water, protein, fat and sugar components and has a creamy colour. Pour it between containers or mix through the ordinary liquid system. Diseased stock can contaminate the liquid; spots do not certify health.

Keep the cage fed, clean and roomy. Milk does not change native litter size, meat yield or sale premiums.

book.welcome.name: book.fish.name
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Aquaculture: Selected Lines

book.welcome.name: book.fish.tank.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Keep the native tank

book.welcome.name: book.fish.tank.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: These are the original tilapia, gutter tilapia, graft tilapia, eels, electric eels and sturgeon. Individual fish keep their species IDs, tank space, power, water, diets, waste, predation and harvesting rules. Selected juveniles still need raising. Colours do not make a fish immune to poor care.\n\nOpen Quayside's FISH + CARE shelf and click NEXT SPECIES to cycle through all six fish. The shelf stocks each ordinary colour from day 14 and rare colours from day 28, one individual per weekly offer. Selected eel and sturgeon pairs can now breed through the normal tank lifecycle. Male sturgeon are sold on this shelf; the original sturgeon shop stock remains female. Only females produce caviar. Read each species' normal tooltip.

book.welcome.name: book.fish.appearance.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Colour, fins and patterns

book.welcome.name: book.fish.appearance.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Five standard colour families have distinct male and female palettes: Bronze/Copper, Moss/Olive, Cobalt/Blue-grey, Charcoal/Smoke and Red/Coral. Pearl, Gold and Platinum are three rare colour lines. Eels have Bronze, Olive, Slate, Charcoal and Russet coats, with rare Ivory, Gold and Silver. Sturgeon have Bronze, Olive, Steel-blue, Graphite and Copper, with rare Pearl, Gold and Platinum. The art preserves native fins, plates, scales, outlines and stage sizes.\n\nBody colour, fin colour and markings are three separate inherited pairs. Broad bars, golden bands, blotched pearl, warm-throat, peppered and marbled patterns can combine with red, gold, blue or pale fins. Mixed fin or pattern alleles remain carriers until a matching pair is inherited. Eels instead express lateral ribbons, gold flecks, olive mottling, saddle bands, rare piebald patches or rare ivory marbling. Sturgeon express pale scutes, bronze scutes, silver peppering, copper saddles, rare pearl marbling or rare ivory armour. Default fin genes follow the body's palette. These are simplified game genetics, not a real species' genetic chart.

book.welcome.name: book.fish.breeding.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Breed colour lines

book.welcome.name: book.fish.breeding.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The native laying, fertilisation and hatch loops remain in control for all six species. Eel clutches contain three fry (5% base laying chance, electric eels 4%); sturgeon clutches contain two (3%). Fertilised eggs hatch on the next tank cycle. Eel fry need three fed growth days; sturgeon fry need four. These are balanced game breeding lines, not a simulation of real eel reproduction. Each unfertilised roe cohort records the laying female's genes. A fed adult male of the same species contributes when native fertilisation happens. Keep a single selected pair together to control parentage; with several eligible males, the father is chosen from them.\n\nAt fertilisation, each offspring receives one allele from each parent at every locus, and its sex is fixed. The whole clutch is saved. Fry visibly show those saved colours and markings, simplified at their small size, and keep them as they grow into individual fish. Roe and fry retain both parents' gene pairs through saves. Siblings can differ. Rare colours need two matching alleles; rare x ordinary produces carriers according to the ordinary colour's dominance. New perk and supplier breeding stock can carry common colours and markings. Eggs supplied already fertilised carry a recorded clutch. Two tank parents with only ordinary colour alleles have a 1 in 32 chance per fry of producing a common colour mutation. Previously recorded clutches keep their genes. No cross-species hybrids or extra free fry are spawned.

book.welcome.name: book.fish.traits.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Select useful traits

book.welcome.name: book.fish.traits.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started:
Four inherited gene pairs affect the native aquaculture calculations. Two selected alleles give the full benefit; mixed pairs give intermediate effects.

Meaty: up to 20% faster fed growth progress. Native growth calorie costs remain. Mature, well-grown fish show a fuller body.
Long-lived: up to 30% later native old-age threshold; the original mortality roll remains.
Thrifty: up to 20% less maintenance energy, without reducing growth calorie requirements.
Breeder: up to 40% relative increase to a breedable species' laying chance, capped at 100%. No extra roll, no larger free clutch, and normal fertilisation requirements remain.

Faster growth also advances the native biological-age clock. Combine it with longevity if breeding for longer service. Body weight, fillets, medical grafts, caviar and electric output still use native calculations.

book.welcome.name: book.fish.value.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Recognise and value stock

book.welcome.name: book.fish.value.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Live fish have a pet value. Standard colours add 15%, rare colours add 100%, and most patterns add 10%. The two rare eel and sturgeon patterns add 40% or 60%. Breeding traits add value when you buy or sell a fish. Fry carry their traits until they grow into individual fish.\n\nRats and fish share 40 breeding traits. Young can take after either parent or develop a new trait. Seven traits on one offspring is a one-in-10,000 birth. Upper-level regulars, Amara Dune and Mina Rose buy pets at the counter.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_01.intro
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I am picking up dinner and medical supplies for Velvet Quay. A sealed drink for the walk back would be welcome, too.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_01.gossip_a
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The night tram was late again. Half the quay finished their coffee before it arrived.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_01.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The flowers on the counter are real this week. We are taking turns remembering to water them.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_01.flirt
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: You remembered my usual. Careful, I could get used to that.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_02.intro
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The house kitchen is running low. Show me your food, clean water and medical supplies.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_02.gossip_a
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Someone ordered a new sign for the house. The lettering arrived before the brackets.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_02.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Our bookkeeper can spot a missing credit across a crowded room. It is an impressive talent.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_02.flirt
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Good stock and a welcoming smile. You make this errand rather pleasant.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_03.intro
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Velvet Quay sent me on the supply run. We need meals for the staff and fresh medical stock.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_03.gossip_a
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Our cook is convinced ginger soda belongs in everything. I have negotiated a truce over the soup.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_03.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A courier took the long route just to avoid the puddles. Then the overhead pipe leaked.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_03.flirt
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: If you keep saving my favorite drink, I might start thinking it is personal.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_04.intro
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A long evening goes better with a proper meal. I am shopping for food, drinks and medical supplies.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_04.gossip_a
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A dockworker swore your bottled water tastes better. Now everyone wants to compare labels.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_04.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The staff room has a new chair. We held an election to decide whose old chair it replaces.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_04.flirt
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I was going to hurry back, but you are very easy to talk to.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_05.intro
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I have the house shopping list: food first, then medical supplies, and something cold to drink.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_05.gossip_a
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The upstairs lounge has a new music player. So far it knows exactly one song.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_05.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A regular keeps recommending restaurants they have never actually visited. Very economical expertise.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_05.flirt
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: You have a way of making a supply run feel like the best part of my evening.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_06.intro
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: We used up the last of the break-room snacks. I can take food and drinks, and medical supplies for the cupboard.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_06.gossip_a
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: One of the women is learning to repair pumps. She says it is mostly listening carefully.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_06.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: We have started sharing our shopping lists. It saves five people making the same trip.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_06.flirt
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: That smile is dangerous for someone trying to keep to a shopping list.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_07.intro
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I am off the clock and buying for the house. What have you got in food, clean drinks and medical supplies?

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_07.gossip_a
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A supplier tried selling us empty boxes as premium packaging. We sent the premium boxes back.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_07.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The night market has three stalls all claiming to sell the original recipe. Quite a family dispute.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_07.flirt
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Maybe I will take the scenic route past your shop again tomorrow.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_08.intro
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'm shopping for the late shift. Any decent food or medical supplies?

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_08.gossip_a
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The market awnings are being patched. Pick your walking route by the weather, not the map.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_08.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Our lighting technician fixed the corridor by tapping one panel. I wish I knew which panel.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_08.flirt
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Keep being this charming and I will start volunteering for every supply run.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_09.intro
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I promised to make this a quick supply run. Meals, sealed drinks and medical supplies are on my list.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_09.gossip_a
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: We keep a list of shops that treat the staff well. Word gets around surprisingly quickly.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_09.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I brought a friend through the market yesterday. She judged every stall by the smell of its cooking.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_09.flirt
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I like a person who takes pride in their work. It suits you.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_10.intro
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Velvet Quay needs a dependable shop. Let me see your food and medical stock.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_10.gossip_a
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The house cat has chosen the clean towel shelf. Apparently that makes it her office.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_10.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Someone at the house is growing mint in an old filter housing. It seems happy enough.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_10.flirt
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The others asked why I chose this shop. I may have mentioned the company.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_11.gossip_a
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A visitor asked where everyone buys their snacks. I said I was still gathering evidence.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_11.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The new doormat is already missing. I suspect the wind, but the cat is refusing to comment.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_12.gossip_a
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Our afternoon shift has started a recipe book. Most of the pages are arguments about spice.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_12.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Our singer has learned a new chorus. By tomorrow, every room will know it too.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_13.gossip_a
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The quay tailor is teaching evening classes. I can mend a sleeve without sewing it shut now.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_13.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: People remember a shop that has their usual drink. It is a small thing, but it matters.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_14.gossip_a
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Someone won a crate of citrus at cards and discovered how much fruit one crate actually holds.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_14.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The staff traded shifts so everyone could see the market lights. The schedule now looks like a puzzle.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_15.gossip_a
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The lift at the west end sings between floors. Nobody agrees whether that is an improvement.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_15.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A neighbor is organizing a shared delivery cart. I volunteered the route, not the pushing.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_16.gossip_a
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The staff are saving for a better kitchen cooler. Cold drinks settle more arguments than you would think.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_16.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The house kettle whistles a little out of tune. Our singer says she can work with it.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_17.gossip_a
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I heard a musician trade a whole set of strings for a decent dinner. Fair exchange, apparently.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_17.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: We tested three brands of noodles on our break. The cheapest one won. Nobody expected that.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_18.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Someone brought a board game to the lounge. We are still negotiating the rules.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_19.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The delivery driver learned our names before learning which door to use. A promising start.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_20.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: We have a good-stock shelf now. Putting something there is the highest compliment our cook gives.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_21.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: One of the women is making a coat from old curtains. You would never guess until she tells you.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_22.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The house radio found a station that reads poetry between shipping notices. I rather like it.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_23.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A visitor asked me for a trustworthy shop. Reliability is surprisingly difficult to advertise.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_24.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Our cleaner has declared war on glitter. I would put my money on the cleaner.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_25.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The quay bakery sells out before my shift ends. I may have to make friends with their delivery crew.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_26.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The staff are pooling their orders this week. Buying together leaves more time for an actual break.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_27.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Someone repaired the bench outside the house. Now everyone is arguing over who gets the sunny end.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_28.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: We found an old recipe tin while cleaning. Half the measures say just enough. Very helpful.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_29.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Our bookkeeper says the quietest person at a table usually knows the most. I have been testing that theory.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_30.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A reliable supplier gets recommended to friends, cousins and neighbors. It adds up.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_31.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The house plants survived another busy week. That makes them senior staff now.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_32.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The women want a blind soda tasting after the late shift. I volunteered to buy the samples.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_33.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A shopkeeper who remembers the staff as people gets remembered in return. That is how the quay works.

book.welcome.name: visitor.upper_01.intro
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I am shopping for good food, sealed drinks and treats for the household. Show me what is fresh.

book.welcome.name: visitor.upper_01.gossip_a
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The salon is debating which soda deserves proper glassware. I think the answer is all of them.

book.welcome.name: visitor.upper_01.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: My friends keep asking where I found these drinks. I prefer a reliable shop to an impressive address.

book.welcome.name: visitor.upper_02.gossip_a
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Someone served ordinary noodles at a formal dinner and called them a rediscovered tradition.

book.welcome.name: visitor.upper_02.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The latest fashion is to praise simple food in very complicated language.

book.welcome.name: visitor.upper_03.gossip_a
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The galleries are preparing another opening. Everyone remembers the refreshments first.

book.welcome.name: visitor.upper_03.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I am organizing a small evening gathering. Small is a surprisingly flexible word to my guests.

book.welcome.name: visitor.upper_04.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Our cook wants to know who supplies your ingredients. I told her to ask you herself.

book.welcome.name: visitor.upper_05.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: One of my neighbors collects empty bottles. I am helping with the enjoyable half of that hobby.

book.welcome.name: visitor.upper_06.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A tasting party is a wonderful way to discover that nobody agrees about sweetness.

book.welcome.name: visitor.upper_07.gossip_b
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The upper lifts are crowded today. I would rather wait here with a decent drink.

book.welcome.name: visitor.mara_voss.intro
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The crew can lift a purifier. Keeping the crew hydrated costs more.

book.welcome.name: visitor.mara_voss.gossip
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I can carry the tank. Getting it through the door is the engineering problem.

book.welcome.name: visitor.sigrid_renn.intro
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Water outside the suit is plentiful. Drinking water is another matter.

book.welcome.name: visitor.sigrid_renn.gossip
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The crew took a break under the new crane. Someone finally built a roof at the right height.

book.welcome.name: visitor.tesa_morrow.intro
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: She buys reliable machines and asks exactly how they were tested.

book.welcome.name: visitor.tesa_morrow.gossip
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Our water allowance was written for ordinary workers. We are renegotiating it.

book.welcome.name: visitor.anika_rook.intro
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A supply convoy needs a dependable merchant at each end.

book.welcome.name: visitor.anika_rook.gossip
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The dock tailor charges by the meter. We keep that business alive.

book.welcome.name: visitor.branna_kest.intro
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Her weekly order starts with drinks and ends with half the warehouse.

book.welcome.name: visitor.branna_kest.gossip
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: They replaced the break-room bench again. This one has proper steel bracing.

book.welcome.name: visitor.dalia_sorn.intro
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A fair first order can become a standing contract.

book.welcome.name: visitor.dalia_sorn.gossip
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A crane can lift more, but it cannot tell you whether the load is packed badly.

book.welcome.name: visitor.iona_rusk.intro
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The crew pays on delivery. The harbor authority would prefer they did not.

book.welcome.name: visitor.iona_rusk.gossip
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The fleet needs proper meals and drinking water before another run.

book.welcome.name: visitor.tarek_vale.intro
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: He cares less about the label than how many crates fit below deck.

book.welcome.name: visitor.tarek_vale.gossip
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A pirate can survive a bad bargain. Bad drinking water is harder to negotiate with.

book.welcome.name: visitor.nessa_vek.intro
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Her salvage is cheap because it still needs work.

book.welcome.name: visitor.nessa_vek.gossip

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_piet_lorn.arrest.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Piet Lorn, returning the key doesn't settle the missing stock.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_piet_lorn.arrest.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I know. I hoped it might settle one thing.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_piet_lorn.returnVisit.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Found a day's work washing trays. Nobody lets me near the store room.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_piet_lorn.returnVisit.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Fair enough. The trays don't look at me like they remember.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_piet_lorn.returnVisit.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I can afford the less sad meal today.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_piet_lorn.returnQuestioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I paid back part of it. A small part, before you ask.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_piet_lorn.returnQuestioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The crew didn't ask me to steal for them. That's another bit people leave out.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_veda_brask.arrival.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Something plain. The young cook at the market puts sauce on the sauce.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_veda_brask.arrival.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: And a drink that tastes of what the label says.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_veda_brask.arrival.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I've been selling food longer than he's been standing upright.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_veda_brask.repeat.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'm waiting to see whether you recommend the expensive one.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_veda_brask.questioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: My name was good for thirty years before that inspector arrived.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_veda_brask.questioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Yes, I changed the packing dates. The stock wasn't moving, and I wouldn't take the loss.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_veda_brask.questioned.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: There. You've got the admission. I don't expect thirty years to rub it out.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_veda_brask.dealAccepted.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Plain, properly packed, fairly priced. Nothing wrong with that.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_veda_brask.departure.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Keep an eye on your oldest stock. Don't start making excuses for it.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_veda_brask.arrest.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Leave the scarf. I can hear you perfectly well with it on.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_veda_brask.arrest.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Veda Brask, we're taking you in over the falsified dates and spoiled stock.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_veda_brask.arrest.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Then tell the inspector to speak to me, not shout over my assistant.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_veda_brask.returnVisit.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: My assistant opened her own stall. Sensible girl.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_veda_brask.returnVisit.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: She dates everything where the customers can see it.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_veda_brask.returnVisit.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A simple meal again. I'm getting used to being on this side of a counter.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_veda_brask.returnQuestioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I've heard who's complained. I used to know their orders by heart.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_veda_brask.returnQuestioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Harder to call it a loss on paper when you remember the people.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_harlan_quill.arrival.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A filling meal. I don't need a recommendation, just something hot.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_harlan_quill.arrival.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The night shift ruins your appetite until the wrong hour.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_harlan_quill.arrival.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'll take a drink with it. Make that part straightforward.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_harlan_quill.repeat.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'm still here. You don't have to keep checking.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_harlan_quill.questioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I told the men to keep quiet. I burned the inspection book. Both things happened.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_harlan_quill.questioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A worker was hurt and I thought the place would close if the record got out.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_harlan_quill.questioned.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: What I meant was that I'd lose my position. The place wasn't what frightened me.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_harlan_quill.dealAccepted.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Count it. I don't leave accounts open.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_harlan_quill.departure.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'll eat outside. You've got customers coming.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_harlan_quill.arrest.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: They've already told you about the book, haven't they?

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_harlan_quill.arrest.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Harlan Quill, the witnesses have given statements. You're coming with us.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_harlan_quill.arrest.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Tell them I won't be going back to the yard tonight.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_harlan_quill.returnVisit.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Nobody calls me foreman now. Takes less getting used to than I expected.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_harlan_quill.returnVisit.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: They've hired someone from the day crew. He keeps copies of everything.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_harlan_quill.returnVisit.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A meal to take away. I don't need to take up a chair.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_harlan_quill.returnQuestioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I haven't spoken to the injured man's family. They asked me not to.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_harlan_quill.returnQuestioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: For once I'm doing what someone else asked.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_rafe_orlick.arrival.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Food for walking, please. Nothing that needs a plate.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_rafe_orlick.arrival.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'm taking the long route out of this district. Again.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_rafe_orlick.arrival.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Do your bottles leak if you carry them sideways? I'd rather ask first.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_rafe_orlick.repeat.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Sorry, thought I heard someone call. What was the price?

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_rafe_orlick.questioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I was carrying a sealed dispatch. I still am. I never opened it.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_rafe_orlick.questioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The route went through a firing line. I turned around, and then I kept going.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_rafe_orlick.questioned.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: They can call me a deserter. The spying charge people keep adding is their own invention.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_rafe_orlick.dealAccepted.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: That's enough for the road. I'll pack it carefully.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_rafe_orlick.departure.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: If somebody asks which way I went, at least let me get my lunch finished.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_rafe_orlick.arrest.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The dispatch is inside my coat. Still sealed. Please record that.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_rafe_orlick.arrest.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Rafe Orlick, you're wanted for leaving duty with official correspondence.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_rafe_orlick.arrest.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Then record what it is, too. A letter. Not a stolen radio code I sold somebody.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_rafe_orlick.returnVisit.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Walked the long way round and ended up back here. Remarkable navigation.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_rafe_orlick.returnVisit.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'm trying to find someone who'll accept the dispatch without opening it first.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_rafe_orlick.returnVisit.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Another walking lunch, if you have one.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_rafe_orlick.returnQuestioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: No, the seal isn't broken. I check it more often than my pockets.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_rafe_orlick.returnQuestioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: You'd think carrying one unopened letter would get less complicated.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_zoya_halvek.arrival.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A hot meal. I'll stand if the chair's occupied.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_zoya_halvek.arrival.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Still getting used to eating when I'm hungry instead of when a bell says so.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_zoya_halvek.arrival.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Water will do. I've had enough burnt coffee for one lifetime.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_zoya_halvek.repeat.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'm watching the door out of habit. It isn't your shop.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_zoya_halvek.questioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I struck him. Once. I won't pretend I tripped.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_zoya_halvek.questioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: He ordered civilians into a lane nobody had checked. I argued, he laughed, and I hit him.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_zoya_halvek.questioned.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: There were better things I could have done between the argument and my fist. I missed them.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_zoya_halvek.dealAccepted.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Good. A transaction without a briefing beforehand.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_zoya_halvek.departure.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'll clear the cup away. Hard habit to break.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_zoya_halvek.arrest.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: You don't need three people to walk me out.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_zoya_halvek.arrest.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Zoya Halvek, assault on a superior officer and absence from duty.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_zoya_halvek.arrest.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: He was my superior in rank. Put whatever else you like on the form.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_zoya_halvek.returnVisit.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I found work carrying supplies. Nobody asks me to salute the boxes.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_zoya_halvek.returnVisit.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: They still tell me where to stand. Apparently that part is universal.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_zoya_halvek.returnVisit.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Same kind of meal. I liked knowing what it was.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_zoya_halvek.returnQuestioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The civilians got moved somewhere else. I heard that much.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_zoya_halvek.returnQuestioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Doesn't change the assault. I know which part of the story belongs to me.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_kellan_dorn.arrival.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A drink, please. My mouth's dry from answering questions all morning.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_kellan_dorn.arrival.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Administrative questions. They find you even outside the office.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_kellan_dorn.arrival.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Something light to eat as well. I forgot breakfast.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_kellan_dorn.repeat.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: No, I'm not waiting for someone. Just thinking too loudly.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_kellan_dorn.questioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Some of the exemptions were genuine. I made sure those went through.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_kellan_dorn.questioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The others were invented. I accepted payment from families who believed their sons and daughters were safe.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_kellan_dorn.questioned.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I kept telling myself I'd fix the records before the next call-up. That was a useful lie.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_kellan_dorn.dealAccepted.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Thank you. At least this purchase has a simple result.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_kellan_dorn.departure.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'll take the receipt, if there's one. Habit, I'm afraid.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_kellan_dorn.arrest.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The families didn't know. Please don't question them as accomplices.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_kellan_dorn.arrest.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Kellan Dorn, we're questioning you about the exemption papers you sold.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_kellan_dorn.arrest.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I have their names. The people who need to be told first.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_kellan_dorn.returnVisit.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I saw a queue outside the recruitment office and crossed the street.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_kellan_dorn.returnVisit.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Not a noble response. Just the one I managed.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_kellan_dorn.returnVisit.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Could I sit with a drink for a minute before I go back out?

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_kellan_dorn.returnQuestioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I've written some of the families. Others don't have a reliable address.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_kellan_dorn.returnQuestioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Turns out I was much better at finding people when they were paying me.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_ansel_trask.arrival.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A meal and something cold. I've been listening to a generator all morning.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_ansel_trask.arrival.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: After thirty years in signals, I hear every loose panel in a building.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_ansel_trask.arrival.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Your fan is all right. Don't look so worried.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_ansel_trask.repeat.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'm giving my ears a rest. Take the time you need.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_ansel_trask.questioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The radios were old, not written off. I knew the distinction.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_ansel_trask.questioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I sold them and said the proceeds would cover the crew's unpaid work.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_ansel_trask.questioned.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Then I kept the money. There isn't a technical explanation for that part.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_ansel_trask.dealAccepted.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Good food, quiet corner. Worth the walk.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_ansel_trask.departure.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Keep that fan serviced. Silence costs more after something breaks.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_ansel_trask.arrest.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I can hear you. Lower your voice; the whole street doesn't need the details.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_ansel_trask.arrest.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Ansel Trask, we're recovering the radio equipment sold from your section.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_ansel_trask.arrest.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: You'll need the buyer list. I kept that much in order.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_ansel_trask.returnVisit.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: One of the crew passed me in the street. Didn't bother swearing.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_ansel_trask.returnVisit.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I think I preferred it when they still had something to say.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_ansel_trask.returnVisit.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A cold drink again. I'll keep out of the doorway.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_ansel_trask.returnQuestioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I sold my own set to repay some of it. The room's quiet now.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_ansel_trask.returnQuestioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I used to like quiet. Depends what you can hear yourself thinking.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_dima_hest.arrival.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Food and a drink. I can carry both; no extra wrapping needed.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_dima_hest.arrival.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: People think supply work is boxes. Mostly it's finding out who lied about the boxes.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_dima_hest.arrival.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: You keep a tidy stockroom, from what I can see.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_dima_hest.repeat.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'm adding it up. I like knowing the total before anything moves.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_dima_hest.questioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Rations and coats. The quantity on the notice is close enough.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_dima_hest.questioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I sold them through a civilian buyer. The unit filed shortages while my account filled up.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_dima_hest.questioned.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I could tell you the stores were mismanaged already. That wouldn't explain my money.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_dima_hest.dealAccepted.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Inventory down, till up. The honest version is pleasantly simple.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_dima_hest.departure.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Don't let anyone sign for stock they haven't counted.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_dima_hest.arrest.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Don't pull at the buttons. Two of them are barely attached.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_dima_hest.arrest.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Dima Hest, you're wanted over the diverted rations and winter clothing.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_dima_hest.arrest.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I've got the depot numbers. You'll want those before you start searching warehouses.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_dima_hest.returnVisit.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: It's getting colder. I notice the coats on people more than I used to.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_dima_hest.returnVisit.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: That sounds like remorse rehearsed for an audience. I know how it sounds.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_dima_hest.returnVisit.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Just the food. I can spare the cost of the drink today.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_dima_hest.returnQuestioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: No, I haven't replaced everything. Some of it's long gone.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_dima_hest.returnQuestioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I used to call missing things a discrepancy. I have less use for that word now.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sorrel_baines.arrival.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Water and something filling. I've walked farther than any vehicle I've repaired lately.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sorrel_baines.arrival.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I keep hearing engines and thinking they sound wrong. Sometimes they do.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sorrel_baines.arrival.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: If I stare at your delivery van, that's why.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sorrel_baines.repeat.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'm deciding whether I can carry another bottle. My shoulders say no.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sorrel_baines.questioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I drove a service truck out with injured workers in the back.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sorrel_baines.questioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: It broke down near the repair yard. We got them out and left it there.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sorrel_baines.questioned.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: People say I stole an arms shipment. There weren't any weapons. Ask the workers before you repeat it.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sorrel_baines.dealAccepted.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: That'll keep me moving. I'll carry it on the good shoulder.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sorrel_baines.departure.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The van sounded fine, by the way. One less thing to worry about.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sorrel_baines.arrest.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The truck is still where I said. I didn't sell it.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sorrel_baines.arrest.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Sorrel Baines, you're required to answer for the missing vehicle and absence from duty.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sorrel_baines.arrest.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Then let's answer for the actual vehicle. I'm tired of the other stories.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sorrel_baines.returnVisit.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Someone towed the truck. I saw the scrape marks, not who took it.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sorrel_baines.returnVisit.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I hope they found the fault before trying to drive it uphill.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sorrel_baines.returnVisit.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Food first today. I've already filled my water bottle.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sorrel_baines.returnQuestioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The workers are alive. That's the part I keep checking.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sorrel_baines.returnQuestioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'm not saying it settles the rest. It's just what I needed to know.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_yara_quell.arrival.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A meal that stays down on rough water. Your plainest one will do.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_yara_quell.arrival.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The canal's busy, which means everyone thinks they've got right of way.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_yara_quell.arrival.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Give me a sealed drink too. River spray improves nothing.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_yara_quell.repeat.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'm waiting for my stomach to agree with the smell of food.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_yara_quell.questioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Undeclared cargo, yes. Payments to dock inspectors, yes.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_yara_quell.questioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I've also carried people who couldn't get through the official gates. Don't put them on the inventory with the crates.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_yara_quell.questioned.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Some trips were decent work. Other trips paid for them. I know that isn't a clean account.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_yara_quell.dealAccepted.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Wrapped tight. You understand boats better than half the quay.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_yara_quell.departure.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: If the river smells sweet today, don't ask why. Keep walking.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_yara_quell.arrest.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: There's a crew waiting at the south mooring. Tell them to secure the boat.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_yara_quell.arrest.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Yara Quell, we're investigating the cargo and payments on your runs.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_yara_quell.arrest.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Ask about me. Leave the passengers' names out of your market gossip.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_yara_quell.returnVisit.0

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_pella_thorne.questioned.2

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_pella_thorne.returnVisit.0

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_pella_thorne.returnVisit.2

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_pella_thorne.returnQuestioned.1

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_jory_noll.questioned.2
