Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I am considering your offer on behalf of my entire population. Me.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_mina_quince.questioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I charged customs duty on mops. They were crossing a sovereign threshold.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_mina_quince.questioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The caretaker says it was his broom cupboard. He has never produced a constitution.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_mina_quince.questioned.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Stealing the station sign was regrettable. We had no mint, but we needed a seal.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_mina_quince.dealAccepted.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The crown accepts these terms. Here's the exact change.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_mina_quince.departure.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: You may apply for an embassy. Shelving would be sufficient.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_mina_quince.arrest.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I invoke diplomatic immunity and, failing that, the cleaner's spare key.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_mina_quince.arrest.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Mina Quince, your cupboard has been returned to the maintenance department.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_mina_quince.arrest.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Then I request asylum in whichever cell has a window.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_mina_quince.returnVisit.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The kingdom is in exile. I've rented a locker.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_mina_quince.returnVisit.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: It has two shelves. Our territory has doubled in practical terms.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_mina_quince.returnVisit.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'll take something that fits beside the national mop.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_mina_quince.returnQuestioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'm no longer collecting tolls. These are voluntary coronation contributions.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_mina_quince.returnQuestioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Nobody has volunteered. Democracy is proving disappointing.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_orla_sprocket.arrival.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Something fresh, please. I'm quite done with yesterday.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_orla_sprocket.arrival.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I sell travel tickets. Unfortunately most customers insist on traveling forward.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_orla_sprocket.arrival.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The railway has called them fraudulent. I call them historically affordable.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_orla_sprocket.repeat.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Take your time. I've already missed my departure by twenty-three years.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_orla_sprocket.questioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The tickets were genuine. The dates were the problem.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_orla_sprocket.questioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A man demanded a refund because his train left last Tuesday. That was clearly printed.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_orla_sprocket.questioned.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The clock parts were research expenses. The station disagrees about whose research.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_orla_sprocket.dealAccepted.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Excellent. A transaction firmly anchored in the present.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_orla_sprocket.departure.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: If an older version of me asks for credit, refuse her.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_orla_sprocket.arrest.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Could we schedule the arrest for last week? I was free then.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_orla_sprocket.arrest.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Orla Sprocket, you're coming with us in the ordinary direction of time.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_orla_sprocket.arrest.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Predictable. The authorities have never supported innovation.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_orla_sprocket.returnVisit.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I've changed the business model. Souvenirs of journeys you never took.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_orla_sprocket.returnVisit.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Same tickets. Much better reviews.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_orla_sprocket.returnVisit.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: One customer says she remembers a wonderful holiday. I haven't corrected her.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_orla_sprocket.returnQuestioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: No more clocks. I'm working with calendars. Fewer screws.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_orla_sprocket.returnQuestioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The refunds are due tomorrow. Finally a date I can believe in.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sabela_wick.arrival.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A drink for a woman recently returned from the dead.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sabela_wick.arrival.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Not literally. I walked out halfway through my own funeral.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sabela_wick.arrival.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The singer was flat. There are limits to what a person should endure quietly.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sabela_wick.repeat.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I can wait. I've already heard the full eulogy.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sabela_wick.questioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The death claim was false. The catering bill was painfully real.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sabela_wick.questioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I thought I'd listen from the back. Then my aunt described me as punctual.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sabela_wick.questioned.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I stood up to object. Three people fainted and the council canceled the payment.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sabela_wick.dealAccepted.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Thank you. I'll try to remain alive until I've finished it.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sabela_wick.departure.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: If anyone asks, my next engagement is strictly musical.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sabela_wick.arrest.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Please tell the choir this isn't another rehearsal.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sabela_wick.arrest.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Sabela Wick, we need to discuss the funeral funds and your insurance claim.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sabela_wick.arrest.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Certainly. Can we also discuss the review? They gave me two stars.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sabela_wick.returnVisit.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'm singing at weddings now. Fewer opportunities to be recognized in the coffin.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sabela_wick.returnVisit.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The aunt has booked me. She insists on paying after the ceremony.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sabela_wick.returnVisit.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Water, please. Resurrection is hard on the throat.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sabela_wick.returnQuestioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'm repaying the council. The flowers were the expensive part.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_sabela_wick.returnQuestioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: My obituary still says punctual. Some lies are impossible to correct.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_tilda_rook.arrival.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A captain requires a hearty lunch, even in dry dock.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_tilda_rook.arrival.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: My fleet has been impounded. Six baths and a particularly seaworthy washbasin.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_tilda_rook.arrival.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Laugh if you like. The washbasin never once leaked.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_tilda_rook.repeat.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'm inspecting the provisions. Naval procedure.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_tilda_rook.questioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: They call it theft of public fixtures. I call it emergency requisition.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_tilda_rook.questioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: We reached the drainage channel before the tide went out and exposed the wheels.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_tilda_rook.questioned.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The crew mutinied over the lack of towels. Discipline has declined terribly.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_tilda_rook.dealAccepted.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Provisioning complete. A fair price and a generous portion.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_tilda_rook.departure.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: If you hear a foghorn, that's Ethel with a kettle. Don't panic.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_tilda_rook.arrest.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I surrender my command. Not the rubber duck; that's privately owned.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_tilda_rook.arrest.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Tilda Rook, the bathhouse would like its fittings returned.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_tilda_rook.arrest.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'll furnish a manifest. Some of them have acquired names.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_tilda_rook.returnVisit.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The fleet is back in service. Mostly as baths.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_tilda_rook.returnVisit.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I visit on Thursdays. Morale remains damp but respectable.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_tilda_rook.returnVisit.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Have you anything suitable for a captain on half pay?

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_tilda_rook.returnQuestioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I returned the duck too. It belonged to the mayor.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_tilda_rook.returnQuestioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: He offered me a job cleaning the baths. I accepted command of the sponge.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_nerys_bell.arrival.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: If someone looking like me was here earlier, she probably owes you money.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_nerys_bell.arrival.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'm a professional stand-in. Very ordinary work until the original comes back.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_nerys_bell.arrival.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A small meal. I'm paying from my own wages today, to avoid an argument.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_nerys_bell.repeat.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Sorry, were you speaking to me or the idea of me?

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_nerys_bell.questioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I was hired to cover a missing woman's shifts. Then she returned.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_nerys_bell.questioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: She wanted money. I wanted a day off. We subcontracted each other.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_nerys_bell.questioned.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Payroll noticed when both of us applied for the same holiday with different husbands.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_nerys_bell.dealAccepted.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'll sign under my own name. It's been a while.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_nerys_bell.departure.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Please remember this face. I'll do the same.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_nerys_bell.arrest.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Before you say anything, yes, you've got the correct one.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_nerys_bell.arrest.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Nerys Bell, we have both employment files and both signatures.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_nerys_bell.arrest.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Good. Mine is the one that spells my name correctly.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_nerys_bell.returnVisit.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I've found honest work as a mannequin demonstrator.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_nerys_bell.returnVisit.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: They asked for references. I resisted the obvious temptation.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_nerys_bell.returnVisit.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Something warm. Standing still is colder than it looks.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_nerys_bell.returnQuestioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: She's paid back her half. I'm still saving for mine.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_nerys_bell.returnQuestioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: We don't speak now. Apparently I was doing a poor impression.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_petra_soot.arrival.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A little indulgence, please. Estate meetings take so much out of a woman.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_petra_soot.arrival.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: You have a lovely eye for quality. Have you ever considered marrying into it?

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_petra_soot.arrival.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Don't look alarmed. I'm assessing the jewelry cabinet.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_petra_soot.repeat.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I like to examine the terms before I commit. A habit my fiance encouraged.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_petra_soot.questioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Six engagement rings are not six confessions. They're a diversified portfolio.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_petra_soot.questioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: My fiance vanished before signing his will. The police find the timing fascinating.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_petra_soot.questioned.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: So do I. He promised to finish the paperwork on Tuesday.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_petra_soot.dealAccepted.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A pleasure. You negotiate better than my last solicitor.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_petra_soot.departure.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: If a wealthy gentleman asks after me, establish which one first.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_petra_soot.arrest.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Please mind the pearls. They are already disputed property.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_petra_soot.arrest.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Petra Soot, you're being detained over the disappearance and the altered estate papers.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_petra_soot.arrest.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: At last, someone has arranged a meeting with all the interested parties.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_petra_soot.returnVisit.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The estate is frozen. I had no idea money could be so inconsiderate.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_petra_soot.returnVisit.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: One of the rings was glass. That hurt more than the accusation.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_petra_soot.returnVisit.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Something modest today. Modest can still be beautiful.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_petra_soot.returnQuestioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: He has been seen at the races. Alive, apparently, and backing terrible horses.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_petra_soot.returnQuestioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'm relieved. My solicitor says I must keep emphasizing that part.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_vera_latch.arrival.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Something sweet. I've spent the morning explaining a very complicated engagement.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_vera_latch.arrival.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Three engagements, technically. Each gentleman believes the others are my accountants.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_vera_latch.arrival.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: They are all terribly good with money, until I'm involved.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_vera_latch.repeat.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I don't rush decisions. That's how I ended up with three wedding dates.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_vera_latch.questioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I charged them for the same honeymoon. It seemed wasteful to book three suites.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_vera_latch.questioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Then I sent them together. I thought the sea air might improve their understanding.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_vera_latch.questioned.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: They came home as friends. You cannot imagine how inconvenient that has been.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_vera_latch.dealAccepted.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Beautifully presented. You deserve a better review than my travel agent.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_vera_latch.departure.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: If anyone asks, I'm temporarily uninterested in accountants.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_vera_latch.arrest.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Could I call my fiance? You'll have to be more specific, won't you?

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_vera_latch.arrest.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Vera Latch, all three complainants have signed the statement.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_vera_latch.arrest.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: They're coordinating again. I knew that holiday was a mistake.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_vera_latch.returnVisit.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I've taken a real job matching investors with businesses.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_vera_latch.returnVisit.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: There is one contract per investor. Everyone seems absurdly grateful.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_vera_latch.returnVisit.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A little treat. Bought with money whose origin I can comfortably explain.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_vera_latch.returnQuestioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: No weddings planned. One of them did send an anniversary card.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_vera_latch.returnQuestioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: All three signed it. I deserved that.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_luma_pike.arrival.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Your best drink, please. I believe in enjoying the honeymoon period.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_luma_pike.arrival.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The hotel says my loyalty card is unprecedented. Seven stays, one guest remaining.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_luma_pike.arrival.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: They make that sound so sinister. I've always checked out on time.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_luma_pike.repeat.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Take your time. I prefer a long engagement to a rushed purchase.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_luma_pike.questioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: My emergency contact is a probate clerk. He answers his telephone.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_luma_pike.questioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The police say the estates form a pattern. The hotel says the same about my bookings.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_luma_pike.questioned.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I have asked both institutions to stop sharing stationery.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_luma_pike.dealAccepted.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Lovely. Shall we call it a lasting relationship and leave it at that?

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_luma_pike.departure.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Keep your receipt. I hear documentation can become terribly important.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_luma_pike.arrest.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Can I redeem the hotel points before we leave? They're nontransferable.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_luma_pike.arrest.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Luma Pike, the outstanding warrants concern three deaths and the estate claims.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_luma_pike.arrest.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Then we'll need more than the honeymoon suitcase.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_luma_pike.returnVisit.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The hotel has canceled my membership. Apparently the bar gossip reached management.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_luma_pike.returnVisit.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'm living above a bakery. The only inheritance is the smell of yesterday's bread.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_luma_pike.returnVisit.2
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Something small today. My clerk no longer returns calls.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_luma_pike.returnQuestioned.0
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I know what the paper says. I also know smiling won't make it disappear.

book.welcome.name: wanted.neon_wanted_luma_pike.returnQuestioned.1
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: For once, I'd like a conversation that doesn't end with a signature.

book.welcome.name: bar.book.setup.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The small bar

book.welcome.name: bar.book.setup.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started:
Set the tool rail behind your work surface. It holds a measure, mixing glass and shaker; the blender, notebook and serving bottle go beside them. Take any tool into your inventory when needed. It works in either place.

A measure controls quantity. The glass and spoon stir. The capped shaker shakes. A blender extracts juice.

The rail is sold empty. Glassmarket also stocks the tools, bottles and this notebook.

book.welcome.name: bar.book.measure.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Measure, mix, pour

book.welcome.name: bar.book.measure.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started:
Pour from an ingredient bottle into a 25, 50 or 100 mL cylinder. The cylinder stops when full. Pour that measured amount into your mixing glass or shaker. Repeat for each ingredient.

Activate the mixing glass to stir, or the shaker to shake. Pour the finished mixture into a bottle. A cylinder also portions a larger batch.

Leave headroom in the shaker: no more than 600 mL. Stir carbonated drinks.

book.welcome.name: bar.book.juice.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Juice & other mixers

book.welcome.name: bar.book.juice.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started:
Use the ordinary blender with fresh produce and a liquid container. Blender upgrades affect the juice yield. Spoiled produce cannot be juiced.

All fruits work, plus tomato, carrot, beetroot, celery, cucumber and bell pepper. Small or underripe produce yields less. Nutrifruit is the exception: it still blends into water and starch.

Use a sealed soda, reserve water, cordial or tonic on a container with room for its full contents. Empty packaging returns to your inventory. Opened drinks can be measured and mixed.

book.welcome.name: bar.book.glass.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Keep the glass

book.welcome.name: bar.book.glass.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started:
Every ingredient remains part of the liquid when it is poured. Ordinary bottles, jugs and tanks can store a batch. Its colour, quantity and alcohol strength follow its contents.

Water dilutes a drink. Adding another ingredient means mixing again. Pouring a prepared batch into an empty vessel keeps its preparation. Printed bottle labels stay on their original glass.

The following recipes scale up or down. You can also try your own combinations.

Packaging uses the ordinary printer with pattern chips from Undertow Engineering, metal ingots, Metal Printing and CNC modules.

book.welcome.name: guide.water
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: WATERWORKS: the Industrial Water Generator is available at Stormglass Depot Outlet from day 28 with a Grand Waterworks installed, list price 12,500 credits. It generates and fills four native 2 L high-quality water bottles overnight. Fit a charged cell: 6 power each, 24 for all four. No ingredient or empty-bottle input. Existing old inputs and attachments remain retrievable. Starting traits provide no generator.

book.welcome.name: guide.cellar
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: CELLAR: Quayside stocks the Cellar Bench, readable Brewing Notes, bottles and culture. 76 drinks use suitable fruit, grains, starch crops and infusion ingredients. Choose Ferment, Distill or Infuse and load one combination. Batches take nights. The CELLAR tab stores bottles. Use the native powered Age-Well rack to mature suitable wines, cider and perry; bottled spirits do not age for free. Cask rye's recipe includes its own oak stage.

book.welcome.name: guide.bar
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: BAR: Glassmarket stocks a compact tool rail, measures, a mixing glass, shaker, blender, reusable glass and a bartender's notebook. Pour with ordinary inventory targeting. Activate the glass to stir or the shaker to shake; each works on the rail or in your inventory. The ordinary blender extracts fruit and suitable vegetable juices. Store mixtures in native bottles, jugs or tanks.

book.welcome.name: book.tutorial.firstnight.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Your first evening

book.welcome.name: book.tutorial.firstnight.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: After closing, visit Quayside Canning Co-op using the travel menu. Buy a chopping board from KITCHEN + BOOKS, plus an apple and a cabbage from PRODUCE.\n\nBack home, click the arrow at the bottom right of the shop, then click the worktop. Follow First meal in this cubby's Workshop Fieldbook. You do not need to fit a station just to open the kitchen. Keep your guides: their index lets you return to any lesson.

book.welcome.name: book.tutorial.firstmeal.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: First meal: Apple Slaw

book.welcome.name: book.tutorial.firstmeal.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Fit a chopping board in its top kitchen slot. Put one apple and one cabbage in INPUT, then open COOK. Click Apple Slaw and collect it from OUTPUT. This starter recipe needs no water, battery or heating plate.\n\nFor other meals, read their recipe book. Fit the matching tool; supply any listed water and power. A heating plate or galley provides heat for a pan or saucepan, but does not replace the tool. A fridge needs its own battery.

book.welcome.name: book.tutorial.bottling.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Your first bottled drink

book.welcome.name: book.tutorial.bottling.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Open the Manual Bottling Kit. Put the Undertow Bottling Handbook, matching concentrate, water at 99% purity or higher and an empty 350/500 mL can or 750 mL glass bottle in INPUT.\n\nChoose a ready drink in the middle. It uses one concentrate, one container and that container's capacity in water. Collect the labelled drink from OUTPUT. The kit needs no power. Plastic water bottles are not soda packaging. Keep space for the result.

book.welcome.name: book.tutorial.growing.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Plant your first crop

book.welcome.name: book.tutorial.growing.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started:
These crops are genetically modified compact varieties bred for standard hydroponic growers. Even the fruit trees stay small.

Buy fruit or vegetable seed assortments from the Co-op's PRODUCE shelf. Open a packet and put one seed in the vanilla hydroponic unit's seed slot. Add a charged battery and a water container; use the plant analyser to check the crop's nutrient needs.

Growth uses the normal machine cycles, water and plant-health rules. Collect produce and returned seeds from OUTPUT. Healthy crops can yield large and huge produce, just like Nutrifruit. Keep seeds to plant the next generation.

The SEEDS shelf sells packs of three seeds of one crop. Select SEEDS again to switch between fruits and vegetables.

book.welcome.name: book.tutorial.genetics.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Develop your own strains

book.welcome.name: book.tutorial.genetics.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Our crop seeds use the vanilla plant DNA system. Read the DNA Manipulator's instruction note. Put a compatible written trait disk in TRAIT DISK, a seed in TARGET and supply power. Check the operation and success chance before starting.\n\nFor extraction, use the BLANK DISK slot and read the displayed risks. Successful edits can change growth, yield, water demand or produce properties. Returned seeds inherit the parent's traits. Keep a spare strain: edits can fail, and incompatible traits remain restricted.

book.welcome.name: book.tutorial.stuck.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: If the kitchen seems stuck

book.welcome.name: book.tutorial.stuck.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Click the back-room worktop and select COOK. The cabinet's FITTED STATION slot is not the cooking tool selector. Fit tools in the top slots; put ingredients in INPUT and leave OUTPUT space.\n\nNo recipes? Check the exact ingredients, tool, water, power and heating or chilling requirements. TOOL: Chopping Board with heat/work controls is the older interface, retained for an unfinished saved batch. Finish that batch to return to ready recipes. If still stuck, report your version and a full-window screenshot.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_02.personal
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: My mother sings the last verse in Dutch. Even on a noisy night, the whole house goes quiet for it.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_12.personal
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: My sister sent me our gran's Dutch recipe book. There's a tram ticket marking the soup I used to ask for.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_06.personal
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: This braid takes longer than my set. If the clasp goes again, I'm borrowing a clip from the lighting crew.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_33.personal
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Someone put me on door duty because they liked my jacket. Now I get the best seat for the first song.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_01.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: My shoes are under your counter. Sorry. I took them off and now I can't face putting them back on.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_01.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A client called it Brindle Fever. All I know is I'm shivering, and the clinic opens at dawn.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_01.close
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Any of those plain little medicine bottles left? I've got my own money. Could I sit here while you ring it up?

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_01.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Two dinners, please. The woman on coat check always says she's eaten. She hasn't.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_02.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: My mother sang the last verse in Dutch tonight. A man by the door knew every word.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_02.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: He stayed after the show to tell her he'd forgotten what his mother's voice sounded like. She sang it again.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_02.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Got anything soft to eat? I owe my voice a night off.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_03.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Someone booked two men under the name James Bailey. Neither wanted the table once Security came in.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_03.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I've got one pencil left and I'm writing people's real names in ink from now on.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_03.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Tea for the desk, please. Tomorrow's bookings can wait for the kettle.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_04.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A client paid me extra to confess something awful. He'd eaten his flatmate's good cheese.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_04.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Three hours I kept that secret. Now I'm hungry and apparently you know too.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_04.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: You have any cheese? Yes, I see the irony.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_05.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Last tram went past with the lights off. I could see the driver eating his sandwich.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_05.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Part of me wants to complain. The other part wants to know where he got the bread.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_05.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Something for the walk home. Nothing that needs a fork.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_06.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I've had six men ask who does my braid. One actually sat down and let me show him.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_06.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: We missed the opening number. He did the last bit himself, though. Got it dead straight.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_06.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Dinner for one. I'll take the long way home so the mist doesn't undo my hair.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_07.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Someone asked me to sing the song my old partner wrote. Haven't touched it in years.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_07.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I made it through the first verse. The pianist hummed the rest with me.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_07.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A bottle of water for the pianist too. She saved my neck tonight.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_08.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: We voted to get a stool for the door shift. Then we held a meeting about where to put the stool.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_08.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I stood through both meetings. You'll forgive me if I lean on this counter.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_08.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'm feeding the late shift. Something that splits four ways?

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_09.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Got any change? A customer tipped me a coat button and asked for a receipt.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_09.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: It's a lovely button. I still have rent, though.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_09.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Can you hear that squeak? New boots. Everyone hears me coming.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_10.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I did our stock count by candlelight. It says we need fourteen tins of soup and one tin of soap.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_10.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'm fairly sure the cook meant soup. Fairly sure isn't enough. I'll take both.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_10.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Can I have the dented tin? I'll be opening it in ten minutes anyway.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_11.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A regular came in, paid for an hour and asked if we could just sit in silence.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_11.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Quietest money I ever made. Best hour of my week, too.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_11.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Is your fridge humming in B flat? Ours does. I hear it in my sleep.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_12.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: My gran's Dutch soup recipe says to add a handful of onions. You never met my gran. Her hands were enormous.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_12.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Better give me another onion. I'd like this to taste like home.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_12.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Can I keep the soup hot here for a minute? My sister's just across the quay.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_13.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A customer took both our umbrellas by mistake. Came back with three.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_13.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I put them behind the desk. At this rate we'll be selling them by winter.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_13.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Anything small enough for this pocket? The other one's full of keys.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_14.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Three encores in heels. People call it talent. My toes have a different word for it.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_14.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I gave the bouquet to the lighting tech. He's the one who found my heel in the dark.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_14.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Could you tie the parcel? My nails are still wet.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_15.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A client swears he's fine and now half the night's gossip is about Brindle Fever.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_15.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Everybody's a doctor till somebody asks them what time the clinic opens.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_15.close
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I've had enough advice tonight. A sealed drink and something to eat will do until I get seen.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_15.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The sign says open. Please tell me that includes the till.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_16.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Had a client ask if my real name came with the hour. My dear, the tailor who lets out these cuffs has only just earned it.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_16.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: He laughed. We played cards. Turns out he's been introducing himself with a made-up name, too.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_16.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Got a spare minute? I want to finish this drink while it's cold.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_17.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: You remember a tune differently after you sing it to an empty room.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_17.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The cleaner clapped. She said I shouldn't have to pack my own applause away with the mic.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_17.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Honey for my tea if you've got it. We're rehearsing the quiet songs.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_18.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I went in to ask for a raise. Came out with three people's rota changes and a broken stapler.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_18.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'm going back after lunch. Would you mind writing 'raise' on the bag?

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_18.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A sandwich I can eat one-handed. The other hand's keeping this paperwork together.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_19.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Somebody left an engagement ring in the cloakroom. Three people have described it perfectly.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_19.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'm asking them what coat it was in. Funny how nobody remembers the coat.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_19.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Have you seen a coat ticket with a little heart on it? Worth more than my lunch today.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_20.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I took the long way round. They painted over the height marks on my old doorframe.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_20.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: My brother cheated on the top one. Stood on a book. I'd quite like that silly mark back.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_20.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'll take the smaller tin. It fits beside my brother's things.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_21.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: We hung a sign saying the house cat isn't staff. First person in asked for the cat by name.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_21.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I suppose she has regulars. Still hasn't covered a shift for me.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_21.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Fish for the cat, something cheaper for me. Don't look at me like that.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_22.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Someone requested a love song and spent all three verses reading a repair invoice.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_22.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: At the end he kissed the paper. Apparently Joe Wild had knocked a zero off.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_22.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Something for the drummer. He's been paid entirely in applause again.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_23.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'm holding a table for two people who haven't spoken in eight years.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_23.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Set it for four. Their elbows need somewhere to go while they figure out what to say.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_23.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A small box of tea. I can always find two cups.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_24.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I tried telling a joke between numbers. The speaker cut out right before the punch line.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_24.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Biggest laugh I've ever had. I'm taking the sound man to dinner.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_24.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Got something for two? One of us owes the other a laugh.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_25.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I had my eyelids painted gold this evening. It took an hour. I fell asleep before anyone saw them.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_25.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The others let me sleep. Kept saying my act was very modern.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_25.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Anything for breakfast? I've slept straight through dinner.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_26.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I promised a new starter I'd wait until their tram arrived. We watched three go by.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_26.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Fourth one was nearly empty. That was the one they could face. Home now, thank goodness.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_26.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Two waters. I don't like sending anyone to the stop empty-handed.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_27.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: My father never liked my stage name. He used it on a letter for the first time today.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_27.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'm going to frame the envelope. The letter's mostly about his drain.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_27.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Have a dry bag? There's a letter in my pocket I can't let get wet.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_28.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: One of our lads turned a booking down. The client wanted his money back and an apology from the lad himself.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_28.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I counted out his change. He can book an hour here. He can't buy a yes.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_28.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Something to share at the rota meeting. Sweet if it's bad news.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_29.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Someone asked if the flower in my hair was for sale. I said it was my uniform.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_29.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: He offered to buy my uniform. So I sold him an apron from lost property.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_29.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Is there a mirror behind the till? My braid caught on the tram door.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_30.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I need a tin with a lid that fits. Last night the cook and I sorted thirty lids and found one pair.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_30.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: We stood there clapping like we'd just delivered a baby.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_30.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Two identical tins. I am begging you, identical.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_31.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I save the last dance for the people stacking the chairs. Nobody asks them for one.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_31.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Last night the dishwasher swept me clean off my feet. Best shoes in the building.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_31.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A cold drink for the dishwasher. He's earned it.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_32.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: My braid caught a sequin curtain as I walked out. Half the stage set followed me down the quay.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_32.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I picked up every piece. If it sparkles in your doorway, that's the last one.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_32.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Has glitter got into the till? Entirely possible that's my fault.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_33.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Dr. Jackson keeps a clipboard by the counter. I tried doing that at work.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_33.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Within a night somebody had booked the clipboard itself for two private dances.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_33.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Dinner to go. Apparently even office supplies get a break before I do.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_34.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Someone called me brave for working nights. I said my mum worked mornings at the docks.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_34.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Try waking her at four. That's brave.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_34.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'll take two rolls. Mum eats the crusty one on the walk in.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_35.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A client complained the room was too dark. He was still wearing his sunglasses.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_35.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I let him discover it himself. Takes restraint. Put that on my payslip.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_35.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Just water. I've done enough smiling for tips tonight.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_36.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: One of the new girls called in sick and said sorry six times. I used to make that call from this very corner.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_36.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I told her the rota's my problem. A person ought to get ill without doing sums.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_36.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Soup that reheats well, please. I'm leaving it by a friend's door.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_37.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I used to think the hard part was singing the high note. It's remembering who's missing from the front row.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_37.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Tonight somebody sat in his chair. I got all the way through.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_37.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Plain water. The first note tomorrow needs to be mine.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_38.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I'm collecting for an emergency cab fund. One credit each, whenever there's a good night.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_38.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Last week it got a porter home to see his baby before she fell asleep. Worth the jar space.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_38.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Can you break a ten? The little coins are for a fare home.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_39.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A woman asked me to wake her before closing. Didn't want company. She wanted one safe hour of sleep.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_39.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I sat by the door and kept the music down. She tipped me with a peppermint.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_39.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Something minty for the reception desk. I want to pass one on.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_40.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: The delivery slip says six cases. We got six individual lemons wearing paper hats.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_40.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: They're lovely hats. Still five cases and a bit short.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_40.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: How many on a full tray? I count everything twice these days.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_41.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I spent an hour listening to a regular rehearse a breakup. Then he rang his landlord.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_41.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Turns out the great love of his life was a flat with working heat.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_41.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A hot meal, if you have one. My own flat isn't exactly a love story.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_42.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I found an old cassette with my first set on it. My voice shakes so badly you can hear my earring hit the mic.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_42.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I've kept it. Some nights I forget how hard it was just to stand there.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_42.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Something for the walk home. I've got a tape to listen to.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_43.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I use a little star next to quiet bookings. Last night one of the regulars drew one beside my name.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_43.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Nobody disturbed my break. I want to do that for somebody else.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_43.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A meal for the desk. Today I'm taking the whole break.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_44.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: First night at the window in a new suit. A client said I looked just like his ex-husband.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_44.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I've met his ex-husband. I'm keeping the suit.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_44.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Need a drink that won't stain a white cuff. Trust me on this.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_45.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I know the posters say to see Dr. Jackson. I know where his desk is. I'd go now if the clinic were open.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_45.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: What I can do tonight is buy a drink, sit still for a bit, and stop pretending I'm fine.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_45.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: A little water for the tram, please. It's a long way home when you're tired.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_46.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: We ran out of dressing-room hooks. I spent half my shift introducing coats to chairs like guests at a wedding.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_46.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Your velvet sleeve, madam, has been seated beside the till.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_46.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Anything hot left? I finally got a chair of my own.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_47.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I sang a birthday song for a man who'd come in on his own. Quiet little thing.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_47.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: He said it was the first time anyone got his name right. I wrote it on next year's calendar.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_47.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: One sweet thing for a birthday, please. I'll sort the candle.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_48.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I sign the night crew out in pairs. One of them wrote me in on the last line tonight.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_48.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: It didn't occur to me anyone was counting me, too.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_48.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Two drinks with lids. We're catching the same tram.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_49.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Someone asked what a man like me was doing with a flower in his hair. I said, 'Keeping it watered.'

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_49.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: He bought me a glass of water. That might be the best tip I've ever earned.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_49.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Bunch of flowers costs more than lunch. Today I'm having lunch.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_50.opening
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: I bring food back in everyone's order of hunger. The new cook keeps putting himself last.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_50.turn
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Tonight I'm writing his name on the first bowl. With a marker. Let them argue with that.

book.welcome.name: visitor.velvet_50.errand
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Something filling that travels well. I've got people waiting.

book.welcome.name: book.lab.bench.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Working the chemistry bench

book.welcome.name: book.lab.bench.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Buy compound cylinders from Glassmarket. Mix equal measures of the two named stocks with a little water in one cylinder. Try 2 mL of each and 1 mL of water. Heat until both stocks have reacted. Check the mixture with the composition spectrometer. For dry recipes use the evaporator, then select the product in the Chem Finisher. Cards give the minimum heat and the volume per pack.

book.welcome.name: book.lab.clinic.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Clinic formulas

book.welcome.name: book.lab.street.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Street formulas

book.welcome.name: book.lab.clinic.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started:
Bridge Tablet — Quiet Signal + Velvet Static
45 °C · 2 mL · dry

Seam Gel — Switchback + Low Tide
45 °C · 2 mL · may stay wet

Daybreak Injector — Mirror Salt + Redshift
65 °C · 4 mL · may stay wet

Clinic batches need at least 75% active and no residual euphoric, addictive or toxic liquid.

book.welcome.name: book.lab.street.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started:
Yardglass — Dock Chalk + Emberwake
65 °C · 2 mL · dry
Keep water in the cylinder and use LOW. A dry batch on HIGH can end the run.

Prism Chorus — Undertone + Glass Choir
65 °C · 3 mL · dry

Undertint — Lamplight + Night Ink
45 °C · 1.5 mL · dry

Street batches need at least 50% active. A narcotics buyer judges the finished batch by purity.

book.welcome.name: book.bio.split.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Splitting a batch

book.welcome.name: book.bio.split.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Make the first-stage mixture on the heating plate. Before drying or finishing it, split it into two cylinders. For each 6 mL of active compound use 6 mL of just one additive and leave at least 0.5 mL of extra water. Heat to 55 °C. Use fresh juice from the blender or clean milk from a nursing spotted rat. Two competing additives block that branch. Check the spectrometer before finishing.

book.welcome.name: book.wave.safety.title
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Yardglass safety

book.welcome.name: book.wave.safety.body
Neon Undertow: Getting Started: Use water and low heat. A dry mix of Dock Chalk and Emberwake on high heat can explode. If the cylinder rattles, take it off or turn the plate down immediately. Once the countdown starts, the batch is lost and the explosion ends the run.
